notes: The arduino-uno-wifi-rev2 type was matched but is not in the provided catalogue, so it is defined as a new part type.
The diagram labels the breadboard's upper half rows f-j. Under the catalogue naming that is bank 'b' (rows f-j), so the holes are named like '6b.i'.
Column numbers were read from the image: LED legs in columns 6 and 8 (row i), resistor from column 3 to column 6 (row h), green wire into column 3 (row g), black wire into column 8 (row h).
The LED's bent (longer) leg is in column 6 and is taken as the anode. Its other leg is in column 8, which goes to GND, so that leg is the cathode.
The GND pin used is the one in the digital header next to AREF, named GND.3. The power-header GNDs are GND.1 and GND.2.
Pin 2 is the LED control pin, matching ledPin = 2 in the sketch. The sketch also reads A1, but nothing is wired to it.
The software steps (library install, sketch upload, Serial Monitor) are not physical parts, so they are not in the graph.
